description_en: Queries inbound call records based on a conditional query
description_zh: 通过本接口，可以根据条件查询来电通话记录
name: CloudQueryIbCdr

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the call center.

Before calling this operation, create a call center instance in the Cloud Contact Center console and obtain the instance ID from the instance access URL
parameters.help_zh:
呼叫中心 id

调用前需在云联络中心控制台创建呼叫中心实例，并从实例访问地址中获取实例 ID
parameters.name: enterprise_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of a call. If this parameter is not empty, all other parameters are ignored, and only the record matching this unique call ID is returned
parameters.help_zh: 如果uniqueId值不为空，则以下其它参数无效，即仅查询电话唯一标识为uniqueId的记录信息
parameters.name: unique_id

parameters.help_en:
The call result. Parameter description:

1: answered by agent.
2: agent was called but did not answer.
3: answered by system.
4: not answered by system - IVR configuration fault.
5: not answered by system - service suspended.
6: not answered by system - overdue payment.
7: not answered by system - blacklisted.
8: not answered by system - unregistered.
9: not answered by system - ringback tone.
11: not answered by system - call exceeded the maximum limit in the Settings.
12: not answered by system - customer hung up before the system answered.
13: other fault.
14: did not enter queue.
15: abandoned in queue.
16: timeout overflow in queue.
17: no agent available, overflowed in queue.
18: no agent available, did not enter queue.
19: queue full, did not enter queue
parameters.help_zh: 呼叫结果；参数说明： 1:座席接听 2:已呼叫座席，座席未接听 3:系统接听 4:系统未接听-IVR配置错误 5:系统未接听-停机 6:系统未接听-欠费 7:系统未接听-黑名单 8:系统未接听-未注册 9:系统未接听-彩铃 11:系统未接听-呼叫超出营帐中设置的最大限制 12:系统未接听-客户呼入系统后在系统未应答前挂机 13:其他错误 14:未进入队列 15:队列中放弃 16:队列中超时溢出 17:队列中无座席溢出 18:无座席未进入队列 19:队列满未进入队列
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The province to which the customer phone number belongs. Leave this parameter empty to query all provinces. Example: "Beijing". This parameter must be URL-encoded
parameters.help_zh: 客户电话归属省份；为空表示全部，如"四川"，此参数需要URLEncode
parameters.name: province

parameters.help_en: The city to which the customer phone number belongs. Leave this parameter empty to query all cities. Example: "Chengdu". This parameter must be URL-encoded
parameters.help_zh: 客户电话归属城市；为空表示全部，如"成都"，此参数需要URLEncode
parameters.name: city

parameters.help_en:
The type of time range to apply for the startTime and endTime parameters. This parameter takes effect only when both startTime and endTime are specified. Valid values:

1: call start time.
2: call end time.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 查询时间开始结束范围生效类型；通话记录startTime和endTime时间范围生效类型，当startTime和endTime不为空时生效；取值：1.呼叫开始时间 2.呼叫结束时间； 默认为1
parameters.name: time_range_type

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp accurate to seconds. The startTime and endTime values must be within the same month. Default value: the first day of the current month
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间；时间戳格式,精确到s。startTime与endTime不允许跨月，默认值取当前月份第一天
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp accurate to seconds. The startTime and endTime values must be within the same month. Default value: the last day of the current month
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间；时间戳格式,精确到s。startTime与endTime不允许跨月，默认值取当前月份最后一天
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The offset from which to start retrieving records. The value must be greater than or equal to 0. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 从第几条开始取；大于等于0，默认0
parameters.name: start

parameters.help_en: The number of records to retrieve. The value must be greater than 0 and cannot exceed 1000. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 需要取出的数据条数；大于0，最大不能超过1000，默认10
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The key of a user-defined parameter for field-specific search. When this parameter is specified, userFieldValue must also be specified. Only one field can be queried, and fuzzy match is not supported. The custom field-specific search condition is constructed as: {"userFieldkey":"userFieldvalue"}. This parameter must be URL-encoded
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义参数指定查询key；传递该参数时必须传递userFieldValue，仅查询一个字段，不支持模糊匹配， 构造的自定义字段查询条件为:{"userFieldkey":"userFieldvalue"}，此参数需要URLEncode
parameters.name: user_fieldkey

parameters.help_en: The value of a user-defined parameter for field-specific search. When this parameter is specified, userFieldKey must also be specified. Only one field can be queried, and fuzzy match is not supported. The custom field-specific search condition is constructed as: {"userFieldkey":"userFieldvalue"}. This parameter must be URL-encoded
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义参数指定查询value；传递该参数时必须传递userFieldKey，仅查询一个字段，不支持模糊匹配， 构造的自定义字段查询条件为:{"userFieldkey":"userFieldvalue"}，此参数需要URLEncode
parameters.name: user_field_value

parameters.help_en: The phone number of the customer
parameters.name: customer_number

parameters.help_en: The agent ID. You can specify multiple agent IDs separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 座席工号,此字段支持传入多个座席工号，使用英文半角逗号隔开
parameters.name: cno

parameters.help_en: The queue number. Parameter description: -1: did not enter queue
parameters.help_zh: 队列号 参数说明：-1: 未进入队列
parameters.name: qno

parameters.help_en:
The reason for leaving the queue. Parameter description:

2: abandoned in queue.
3: timeout overflow in queue.
4: no agent available, overflowed in queue
parameters.help_zh: 离开队列原因 参数说明： 2: 队列中放弃 , 3: 队列中超时溢出 , 4: 队列中无座席溢出
parameters.name: leave_queue_code

parameters.help_en:
The reason for not entering the queue. Parameter description:

4: no agent available, did not enter queue.
3: queue full, did not enter queue
parameters.help_zh: 未进入队列原因 参数说明： 4: 无座席未进入队列 , 3: 队列满未进入队列
parameters.name: join_queue_code
